author: ViolentBoo
body:
I don't know why but it feels like you should be able to see the reports that you've given off (Only visible to you) and reports about you (this is anonymous so it can reduce player tension)

Just a though because I want to see how many people called hacks on me :3

To be a bit more clear, you can only see the reports online.
